description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [50% Critical (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Sabin)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Sabin)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Fire abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Sabin)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Sabin)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Sabin)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Dual Soaring Spirit 60% Critical] and [Fire Ability +15% Boost 1]/[Dual Soaring Spirit 80% Critical] and [Fire Ability +30% Boost 1]/[Dual Soaring Spirit 100% Critical] and [Fire Ability +50% Boost 1] to all allies after using 1/2/3+ Fire abilities, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1] to the user after using 3+ Fire abilities

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
